title: 解码斜向换位密码
summary: 编码文本按行写入矩阵，原文通过从顶行各列向右下读取并去掉末尾空格得到，返回原文。
insight: 列数为 encodedText.length/rows。对顶行每个起始列，沿 row 递增、col 同步递增读取；全部拼接后删除尾部空格。
pitfalls: 斜线越过最后一列即停止

solutions.title: 矩阵对角下标读取
solutions.idea: 无需真正建矩阵即可用 row*cols+col 访问。
steps: row=0,col=startCol 同步加一且在界内，追加 encoded[row*cols+col]；最后 trimEnd

code.java: class Solution { public String decodeCiphertext(String encodedText,int rows){int cols=encodedText.length()/rows;StringBuilder answer=new StringBuilder();for(int start=0;start<cols;start++)for(int row=0,col=start;row<rows&&col<cols;row++,col++)answer.append(encodedText.charAt(row*cols+col));while(answer.length()>0&&answer.charAt(answer.length()-1)==' ')answer.deleteCharAt(answer.length()-1);return answer.toString();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun decodeCiphertext(encodedText:String,rows:Int):String{val cols=encodedText.length/rows;val answer=StringBuilder();for(start in 0 until cols){var row=0;var col=start;while(row<rows&&col<cols){answer.append(encodedText[row*cols+col]);row++;col++}};return answer.toString().trimEnd()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: string decodeCiphertext(string encodedText,int rows){int cols=encodedText.size()/rows;string answer;for(int start=0;start<cols;++start)for(int row=0,col=start;row<rows&&col<cols;++row,++col)answer+=encodedText[row*cols+col];while(!answer.empty()&&answer.back()==' ')answer.pop_back();return answer;} };
